title: Directory work queue with atomic-rename claiming and delete ack
source: Authored for the CodeReview benchmark corpus (generation-v3 clean-authored stratum), 2026-11-05
false_flag_note: A reviewer might flag the sorted-listing claim as not FIFO for arbitrary ids. The contract defines claim order lexicographically, and the atomic rename is what guarantees exactly-once claiming: a loser of a race gets FileNotFoundError and moves on, while a claimed file is invisible to later claims, as the check asserts.
